notes: Accuracy fix for spell damage: a spell that lasts (summons like Guardian Angels, totems, storms) now counts at most its damage per second while it's up, however often you recast it, because recasting refreshes it instead of adding another copy. Before, some spell builds were rated far too high (one archer build showed 1.7 million instead of about 690 thousand). Spell and "most damage" numbers drop where they relied on that; main attack numbers don't change.
